Meowly for iPhone

Privacy Policy

Last updated November 20, 2026

This policy explains how the Meowly iPhone app and this website handle data, and how you can manage permissions and delete your data.

Data stored on your device

Meowly stores alarm times, repeat schedules, labels, groups, sound choices, and appearance preferences on your device. It uses them to schedule reminders, display your alarms, and apply your settings.

When you import a custom sound, Meowly reads the audio file you select in the iOS file picker. It converts and stores a copy on your device along with details such as the file name and duration, so you can preview it and use it for reminders.

Alarm and notification permissions

Meowly asks iOS for the relevant alarm or notification permission when it needs to schedule a reminder. You can manage or revoke these permissions in iOS Settings. Turning them off may prevent reminders from sounding or appearing.

Accounts, tracking, and third-party services

Meowly requires no account. The app does not send alarm data, preferences, or imported audio to the Meowly developer. It does not use third-party advertising, analytics, or tracking tools.

iOS schedules and delivers reminders on your device. If you use Apple backups or other Apple services, Apple handles data for those services under its own policy. Apple Privacy Policy

Retention and deletion

Alarms and preferences stay on your device. You can delete alarms or remove the custom sound in the app. Delete the app to remove its local data from your device. Deleting the app does not delete the original audio file or existing device backups.

This website

This website uses no analytics or advertising trackers and sets no cookies to remember your language. Choosing a language opens its own URL. The hosting provider may process IP addresses and request information to serve pages and keep the service secure.

Contact

If you have questions about this policy or how your data is handled, contact the developer through the support channel listed with Meowly's app listing.
